items.t: 시진핑 만나는 美 CEO들…“中 개방 기대에도 현장은 쉽지 않아”
items.d: 미국 기업 수장들이 미중 정상회담을 계기로 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 만찬할 예정인 가운데, 중국 사업 여건에 변화가 생길지 주목된다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 중국 시장의 실질적 개방을 약속하지만 규제 불확실성, 패권 경쟁, 경기 침체 속 실제 현장 분위기는 낙관적이지 않다는 평가가 나온다. 21일(현지 시간) 마켓워치 등에 따르면 일론 머스크 테슬라 최고경영자(CEO), 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO, 제인 프레이저 씨티그룹 CEO, 팀 쿡 애플 이사회 의장 등은 24일 시진핑 주석과 만날 예정이다. 매체는 “중국은 이들 기업에 고객이자 생산 공장, 규제 기관, 경쟁 상대”라며 “때로는 이 모든 역할을 동시에 수행하기도 한다”고 풀이했다.◆테슬라, 매출 22%…애플도 15% 중화권테슬라는 지난해 전 세계 총매

items.t: Kairos Power gets up to $100M from Samsung group to build nuclear reactor for Google
items.d: Future Google supplier Kairos Power inked a deal with Samsung C&T to help build its first 50-megawatt nuclear power plant.
items.fullText: Kairos Power has picked engineering firm Samsung C&T to help build its 50-megawatt demonstration reactor for Google , which the nuclear startup is aiming to have completed by 2030. As part of the deal, Samsung C&T will make an equity investment in Kairos and provide “in-kind” engineering services, the combination of which is worth up to $100 million, Kairos Power said Monday. The equity investment will make up $70 million of the total, a Kairos spokesperson told TechCrunch. Samsung C&T has built or helped build about a dozen nuclear reactors around the globe. Kairos is part of a wave of nuclear startups that have benefited from the surge in power demand from AI data centers. Google first signed a deal with the company in fall 2024 , calling on Kairos to build nuclear reactors capable of generating about half a gigawatt of electricity by 2035. Currently, Kairos is building two reactors in Oak Ridge, Tennessee. The first, Hermes 1, is a low-power demonstrator that will help the company refine its commercial design. The second, Hermes 2, is Kairos’ first commercial-scale reactor. Output from Hermes will count as the first 50 megawatts of its deal with Google. The startup received approval from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission in late 2024 to build the reactors. It expects Hermes 2 to begin operating in 2030, in line with its original agreement with Google. Hermes 2 will be a fluoride salt-cooled high-temperature reactor, a design that has been floated for years but never built at commercial scale. Fluoride salts have high boiling points, which will help keep pressure levels low. That, in turn, will limit the risk of high-pressure blowouts in case of any parts failures. Kairos is also using a relatively new form of nuclear fuel known as TRISO, which encapsulates tiny seeds of uranium fuel in layers of ceramic and carbon, which are then loaded into billiard ball-sized spheres. items.t: Elon Musk’s latest Boring Company pitch involves a Hyperloop between Austin and San Antonio
items.d: Many of The Boring Company's announced projects have not materialized.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 12:38 PM PDT · September 20, 2026 Image Credits: Benjamin Fanjoy / Getty Images Anthony Ha Elon Musk’s latest Boring Company pitch involves a Hyperloop between Austin and San Antonio Elon Musk recently claimed that his tunneling startup The Boring Company is working on “a simple precursor Hyperloop” between Austin and San Antonio that will reduce the journey between the two cities to less than 30 minutes. The Boring Company account shared Musk’s statement and said it “would be excited and honored to build this massive infrastructure project.” Many of The Boring Company’s announced projects — including tunnel systems in Chicago, Los Angeles, and between New York City and Washington, D.C. — have not materialized . However, it does operate a transportation system combining tunnels and surface routes in Las Vegas, and it recently raised a $3 billion round led by the United Arab Emirates . Musk’s comments about a potential Austin-San Antonio Hyperloop were actually in reply to an AI-generated video depicting a generic science fiction future with human colonies on other worlds. Musk re-posted the video and declared, “This is the future we shall bring into being”. Musk’s critics have argued that his vision of the future is apparently inspired by pulp science fiction and comic books; historian Jill Lepore recently told me that he seems to favor sci-fi that “completely defeats and defies all of his political beliefs.” This is the future we shall bring into being pic.twitter.com/8aD0w8MDVc — Elon Musk (@elonmusk) September 20, 2026 Topics Elon Musk , hyperloop , In Brief , The Boring Company , Transportation October 13 – 15 San Francisco Last day to book an exhibit table is September 18. items.d: “Musk”, the new four-hour documentary from director Alex Gibney, has been gaining buzz after appearances at film festivals in Venice and Toronto and chronicles the life of Elon Musk through his early days in Silicon Valley to his actions in politics. NPR technology correspondent Bobby Allyn saw the film and talks with NBC News’ Gadi Schwartz about its message.
